cohort: A subsample of 400 young primiparous women who were prenatal at intake, divided into an antenatally depressed group (40%) and a healthy group.
finding: Antenatally depressed and healthy groups had similar pregnancy characteristics and birth outcomes, but the antenatally depressed group reported more child behavioral problems, and in both groups, a steeper increase in maternal depressive symptoms over time predicted more mother-reported child behavioral problems.
